controls.requirement: Generate sovereignty-tier root keys inside Egypt-controlled HSMs.
controls.test: Verify key origin and attempt export.

controls.requirement: Require M-of-N approval across separate reporting lines for root and recovery operations.
controls.test: Attempt operation with fewer than M participants.

controls.requirement: Maintain distinct roots for identity, policy, recovery and evidence signing.
Assign unique identities to humans, workloads, agents, devices, robots and data products.
Use phishing-resistant authentication for privileged human access.
Issue short-lived attested workload and agent credentials.
controls.test: Replay after expiry and outside the attested runtime.

controls.requirement: Replace standing privilege with approved just-in-time grants where feasible.
Disable vendor support access by default.
Implement emergency access as sealed quorum authority with automatic expiry.
controls.test: Activate without quorum and reuse after expiry.

controls.requirement: Bind decisions to tenant, purpose, delegation, audience, resource and action.
Prevent child agents from amplifying parent authority.
Fail closed for material actions when policy state is unavailable or stale.
Preserve source authorization through RAG ingestion, index, cache, retrieval and answer generation.
Pass signed, scoped biometric assertions rather than raw templates into authorization.
Measure deployed-context false-match and false-non-match behavior and require review for consequential decisions.
Segment cameras, access controllers, robots and vehicles with default-deny egress.
Require attestation, safety readiness, model identity and exact short-lived action lease.
Retain an independently administered append-only copy of material security events.
controls.test: Attempt alteration and deletion from the source system.

controls.requirement: Admit only pinned and verified artifacts through staging with SBOM and rollback.
Export and restore identities, policies, metadata and evidence into a clean replacement environment.
Maintain local staff, runbooks, source and artifacts required for independent recovery.
